correctness.rationale: The exact scalar recursion yields iid refresh cycles. The cycle-sum recursion gives \(m=2/(1+s)\) and an explicit second moment \(Q\); hence \(\psi_n(s)-1=2s[(n+2)s^2-ns-2n]/[(1+s)(n+2ns-(n+1)s^2)]\). The denominator stays positive through the positive root, and finite within-cycle second moments plus regenerative decomposition make \(\psi_n(s)<1\) equivalent to all-time mean-square convergence.
